protocol.holdout_rule: complete higher-voltage acquisition for each material
protocol.temperature_reference: mean of CH1..CH6 at first lower-voltage training frame, unchanged for all roles

physical_method.method: prespecified physical supports with training-trajectory nonlinear least squares
physical_method.equation_family: theta_t = D theta_xx - h theta + c
physical_method.physical_prior: D > 0; h >= 0; no advection or quadratic reaction; source c optional
physical_method.optimizer_coordinates: log(D), h/0.01, c/0.1, with absent parameters omitted
physical_method.training_residual: four interior rollout errors excluding initial frame, divided by sqrt(count)
physical_method.start_selection: lowest training RMSE among successful starts; no development or final input
physical_method.failed_start_handling: record exception or failure and continue remaining fixed starts
physical_method.failed_support_handling: retain an explicit failed candidate and continue other fixed supports
physical_method.propagator: four-point sine eigenmodes with piecewise-linear measured boundary forcing
physical_method.time_step_group_representative: mean original dt within each numerically equal contiguous block
physical_method.scope: coarse-grid effective parameters; not a proof of a unique continuous PDE
